hmong: Niam ua zaub xam lav tob ntoos rau noj hmo.
english: Mom makes papaya salad for dinner.

hmong: Peb noj dib liab txias txias tom qab ua si sab nraum zoov.
english: We eat cold watermelon after playing outside.

hmong: Lub dib pag do hau no qab zib heev.
english: This honeydew melon is very sweet.

hmong: Kuv muab dib pag tso rau hauv lub tub yees kom txias.
english: I put the cantaloupe in the refrigerator to chill.

hmong: Thov tev daim tawv ntawm cov qos yaj ywm ua ntej hau.
english: Please peel the potatoes before boiling them.

hmong: Nws chais cov nqaij nyias nyias rau hauv lub lauj kaub.
english: They slice the meat thinly into the pan.

hmong: Nkaus taw siav qab zib heev.
english: Ripe mango is very sweet.
note: the model wrote `Txiv nkhaus taw`; the app's mango is `nkaus taw` (ag-nkaus-taw)

hmong: Txiv maj naus pob taub no qaub heev, ces kuv ntxiv piam thaj me ntsis.
english: This lime is very sour, so I add a little sugar.
note: the model wrote `txiv qaub` (lime) and `qab zib` (the adjective 'sweet') for sugar; the app's words are `txiv maj naus pob taub` and `piam thaj`

hmong: Cov nplej hauv teb tab tom daj lawm.
english: The rice in the field is turning golden.

hmong: Peb ci paj kws noj thaum tsev neeg sib sau ua ke.
english: We grill corn when the family gets together.

hmong: Kuv hlais cov dos ua ntej pib ua noj.
english: I slice the onions before starting to cook.

hmong: Niam suam cov nqaij npuas kom zoo ua ntej kib.
english: Mom minces the pork well before frying it.

hmong: Nws txhoov cov zaub rau hauv lub tais.
english: They chop the vegetables into a bowl.

hmong: Kuv tsuav qij kom me me tso rau hauv cov nqaij kib.
english: I finely chop garlic to put in the stir-fried meat.

hmong: Nws zom kua txob nrog qij ua kua liab.
english: They grind chili peppers with garlic to make chili sauce.
note: `qej` → `qij`; `ua kua ntses` → `ua kua liab`, the app's chili sauce (cook-kua-liab)

hmong: Niam hau qe rau peb noj tshais.
english: Mom boils eggs for our breakfast.

hmong: Peb kib nqaij qaib rau noj hmo no.
english: We fry chicken for dinner tonight.

hmong: Nws nthua cov ntses hauv lub lauj kaub kub.
english: They pan-fry the fish in a hot pan.

hmong: Niam cub mov rau tsev neeg noj.
english: Mom steams rice for the family to eat.

hmong: Peb ci nqaij qaib rau tom qab tsev.
english: We grill chicken in the backyard.

hmong: Niam qhwv cov nqaij rau hauv nplooj tsawb ua ntej cub.
english: Mom wraps the meat in banana leaves before steaming it.

hmong: Nws kauv daim nplooj zaub nrog nqaij rau hauv.
english: They roll the vegetable leaf with meat inside.

hmong: Kuv pleev kua ntswv rau saum qhaub cij.
english: I spread sauce on the bread.
note: the model wrote `pleev butter rau saum mov ci` — an English word, and `mov ci` for bread; the app's words are `kua ntswv` and `qhaub cij`

hmong: Thov muab ntsev me ntsis rau hauv cov kua zaub.
english: Please put a little salt in the soup.
